title: Collections of Objects
scope: Free-floating subdivisions designating private collections of objects: all except --Private collections and --Catalogs and collections are used under names of original owners (individual persons, families, corporate bodies); --Private collections and --Catalogs and collections are used under headings for kinds of objects collected.
general_notes: **Subdivide geographically only to bring out the place where the collection is located.

Avoid proposing new subdivisions to be added to the above list. Whenever possible, use one of the subdivisions provided, such as --Art collections, and assign additional headings in accordance with the provisions below to bring out the specific objects.
